message:
## Description ✏️

This PR migrates to using `bun` as a package manager, script runner and test runner.
- Updates all internal package references to use the `workspace:*` syntax.
- Removes `vitest` in favor of `bun`.
- Removes the turbo command `start`.
- Updates the `ci.yml` workflow to use bun.
- Fixes some type issues that arose since `typescript` got upgraded (after deleting the `yarn.lock` file and doing a fresh install).

## Type of Change 🐞

- [ ] Feature - A non-breaking change which adds functionality.
- [ ] Fix - A non-breaking change which fixes an issue.
- [ ] Refactor - A change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature.
- [x] Documentation - A change only to in-code or markdown documentation.
- [ ] Tests - A change that adds missing unit/integration tests.
- [x] Chore - A change that is likely none of the above.

## Checklist ✅

- [x] I have done a self-review of my code.
- [x] I have manually tested my code (if applicable).
- [ ] I have added/updated any relevant documentation (if applicable).
